verdict.rationale: Factory's droid exec is explicitly built to run in CI/CD pipelines with structured I/O and tiered autonomy, and Droid can propose diffs/PRs from delegated tasks, implying it could diagnose and fix a failing pipeline. However, no evidence directly describes a CI-failure-triggered diagnosis-and-PR workflow (e.g., webhook on failed run, automatic root-cause analysis, PR creation tied to a failed check) — the closest documented feature (readiness-report/readiness-fix) targets repo 'agent-readiness' criteria, not live CI failures. Missing for 10: explicit CI-failure trigger/integration, automated root-cause diagnosis of failed jobs, and PR creation flow tied to that failure.
